spec.description: Automatic observability stack for FastAPI with OpenTelemetry: instead of exposing /metrics, all traces, metrics, and logs are collected automatically through OTEL and sent to Grafana LGTM (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Prometheus), with optional S3 persistence and an optimized Docker setup.

spec.expr: sum by(http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service_name", http_status_code=~"2.*", http_target!="/metrics"}) / sum by(http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service_name", http_target!="/metrics"})

sum by(http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service_name", http_status_code=~"5.*", http_target!="/metrics"}) / sum by(http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service_name", http_target!="/metrics"})

spec.title: Trace Logs
spec.description: Traces containing a span emitted by the service

spec.expr: sum by(http_method, http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_sum{service_name="$service_name"}) / sum by(http_method, http_target) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service_name"}) / 1000

spec.title: Otel LGTM Observability - python(FastApi) automatic instrumentalization metrics
